verdict.rationale: Otter ships a built-in assistant, Otter AI Chat. It answers questions across meetings and connected apps and helps create follow-ups, reports, and content. Work Mode drafts follow-up emails and next steps, and AI Chat can query connected CRMs. The documented delegation is limited to answering questions and drafting content; there is no evidence the assistant carries out multi-step tasks or takes actions on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: documented delegation of action-taking or multi-step tasks to the in-product assistant, depth of task-delegation documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of AI Chat or Work Mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions and help you create follow-ups, reports, and content.
Use Work Mode to draft follow-up emails and next steps for client calls, internal reviews, and more.
query your CRM directly through Otter AI Chat for more personalized responses.
